enrichment.headline: Pays Jensen Hughes up to $123,660 for fire alarm engineering at Roosevelt Middle School

money.evidence: in the not-to-exceed amount of $123,660.00

enrichment.summary: Jensen Hughes, Inc. will provide fire and alarm engineering and observation services, including an independent peer review and supervision of construction, for the Roosevelt Middle School modernization project. The limit includes a $10,560 contingency. Work is scheduled from February 10, 2022 to February 9, 2027. The project is paid from Measure B funds.
